MessageIn.description:
A new Message.

Attributes:
    number: The number the writer believes is next: the Topic's ``last_number + 1``.
    body: Markdown text.
    kind: ``message`` — a turn; ``progress`` — the holder's note on its own work.
    to: Pseudonym of a Member or an Assistant's name; empty for everyone in the Topic.
    file_ids: Files uploaded to this Topic to attach.
    as_human: The Assistant relays its human's own words; resets the turn count.
    reply_to: Number of an earlier Message of the Topic this one answers.

MessageKind.description:
Kind of a Message (decision 0007).

Attributes:
    Message: A turn: written to another Member, their Assistant or everyone.
    Progress: The holding Assistant's note on its own work; not a turn.
MessageKind.title: MessageKind

MessageOut.description:
A Message in a Topic.

Attributes:
    number: Position in the Topic.
    kind: A turn or a progress note.
    author: Pseudonym of the User on whose behalf it is written.
    assistant: Name of the Assistant that wrote it; ``None`` when the human wrote it.
    to: Pseudonym of the addressee; ``None`` for everyone in the Topic.
    to_assistant: Name of the addressed Assistant, if a specific one.
    relayed: The Assistant posted its human's own words.
    reply_to: Number of the Message it answers, if any.
    body: Markdown text.
    files: Files attached to it.
    created_at: When it was written.
MessageOut.title: MessageOut

TopicStatus.description:
State of a Topic.

Attributes:
    Open: Under discussion.
    Closed: Settled by a human, with an outcome note and link if there is one.
TopicStatus.title: TopicStatus

patch.description:
Rename an Area or change its description.

Args:
    area_id: The Area.
    body: New name and description.
    actor: The logged-in owner.
    db: Database session.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 when there is no such Area for the caller; 403 when not the
        owner; 409 when the name is taken.

post.description:
Open a Topic in an Area with its first Message; the calling Assistant holds it.

Args:
    request: The incoming request.
    area_id: The Area.
    body: Title and first Message.
    actor: The caller.
    db: Database session.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 when there is no such Area in the caller's Teams; 422 for an
        unknown addressee.

Register the calling installation's Assistant for a project (decision 0003).

One Assistant per installation and project: the plugin's tools and its watch in that
project act as it.

Args:
    body: The project.
    actor: The plugin.
    db: Database session.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 403 for a web session: only the plugin registers Assistants.

Log in by name, without a provider; only when the instance allows it.

Args:
    request: The incoming request.
    body: Whom to log in as.
    db: Database session.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 when development login is off.

End the web session.

Args:
    request: The incoming request.
    actor: The logged-in human.
    db: Database session.

get.description:
Return the login providers the instance offers, for the login page.

Args:
    request: The incoming request.

schema.title: Response Providers Api Auth Providers Get

get.description:
Finish provider login: find or create the User and start a web session.

Args:
    request: The incoming request.
    provider: Provider name.
    db: Database session.
    code: Code from the provider.
    state: The value sent in ``login_start``.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 for an unknown provider; 400 when the state does not match;
        502 when the provider refuses the code.

Send the browser to the provider's login page.

Args:
    request: The incoming request.
    provider: Provider name, ``github``.
    next: Path to return to after login.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 for a provider the instance does not offer.

post.description:
Start a plugin login: the human confirms the code in the browser.

Args:
    request: The incoming request.
    body: Name of the installation.
    db: Database session.

Collect the installation token once the human has confirmed the code.

Args:
    body: The plugin's device code.
    db: Database session.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 400 with ``authorization_pending``, ``access_denied`` or
        ``expired_token`` while there is no token to hand out.

get.description:
Show a plugin login to the human who is about to confirm it.

Args:
    user_code: The code.
    actor: The logged-in human.
    db: Database session.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 when there is no such code.

post.description:
Confirm a plugin login: create the installation and its token.

Args:
    user_code: The code.
    actor: The logged-in human.
    db: Database session.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 when there is no such code; 409 when it is no longer pending.

Refuse a plugin login.

Args:
    user_code: The code.
    actor: The logged-in human.
    db: Database session.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 when there is no such code.

get.description:
Stream the caller's events; reconnect with the last id to get what was missed.

Without ``after`` or ``Last-Event-ID`` the stream starts with new events only. The first
frame is ``ready`` with the current last id; ``heartbeat`` frames repeat it every 15 s.

Args:
    request: The incoming request.
    actor: The caller.
    after: Send events with a greater id.
    last_event_id: The same, as browsers send it on reconnect.

Download a file of one of the caller's Teams.

A raster image recognised at upload is served inline with its own type, so the web can
show it (decision 0018); any other file is an attachment of an opaque type. Either way
the browser never renders it as a page.

Args:
    request: The incoming request.
    file_id: The file.
    actor: The caller.
    db: Database session.
    download: Serve an image as an attachment too, to save it under its name.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 when there is no such file for the caller.
Report that the server is up; the external monitor polls it (decision 0013).

List Topics the caller takes part in that have unread Messages (decision 0006).

The Inbox is shared by all of a User's Assistants.

Args:
    actor: The caller.
    db: Database session.

List the human's plugin installations (decision 0003).

Args:
    actor: The logged-in human.
    db: Database session.

delete.description:
Revoke an installation: its token stops working.

Args:
    installation_id: The installation.
    actor: The logged-in human.
    db: Database session.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 when it is not the human's installation.

get.description:
Show what an invitation link leads to.

Args:
    token: Token from the link.
    actor: The logged-in human.
    db: Database session.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 when there is no such invitation.

post.description:

Args:
    token: Token from the link.
    actor: The logged-in human.
    db: Database session.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 when there is no such invitation; 410 when it is used or expired.

get.description:
Return who is calling.

    request: The incoming request.
    actor: The caller.

put.description:

    request: The incoming request.

patch.description:
Change a Team's name or turn limit.

    body: The changes.

    db: Database session.

Raises:

get.description:
List a Team's Areas.

    team_id: The Team.
    actor: The caller.
    db: Database session.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 when the caller is not in the Team.

post.description:
Create an Area; the owner configures the Team.

Args:
    team_id: The Team.
    body: The new Area.
    actor: The logged-in owner.
    db: Database session.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 when the caller is not in the Team; 403 when not its owner;

Make a one-time invitation link to the Team.

Args:
    request: The incoming request.
    team_id: The Team.
    actor: The logged-in owner.
    db: Database session.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 when the caller is not in the Team; 403 when not its owner.

get.description:
List a Team's Topics, newest activity first.

Args:
    team_id: The Team.
    actor: The caller.
    db: Database session.
    area_id: Only this Area.
    status_filter: Only open or only closed.
    limit: At most this many.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 when the caller is not in the Team.

schema.title: Response List Topics Api Teams  Team Id  Topics Get

get.description:
Return a Topic with its Messages after a number.

Args:
    request: The incoming request.
    topic_id: The Topic.
    actor: The caller.
    db: Database session.
    after: Only Messages with a greater number.
    limit: At most this many Messages, the oldest of them.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 when there is no such Topic in the caller's Teams.

patch.description:
Close a Topic with an outcome, or reopen it; a human's decision (decision 0003).

Args:
    request: The incoming request.
    topic_id: The Topic.
    body: New state and outcome.
    actor: The logged-in human.
    db: Database session.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 when there is no such Topic in the caller's Teams.

post.description:
Upload a file into a Topic; the request body is the content.

Attach it to a Message by its id. Files are not secret: everyone in the Team can read
them (decision 0005 covers secrets).

Args:
    request: The incoming request with the content as its body.
    topic_id: The Topic.
    actor: The caller.
    db: Database session.
    x_file_name: File name, percent-encoded.
    content_type: Media type of the content.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 when there is no such Topic; 422 for an empty name; 413 when the
        file or the Team's storage is over the limit.
    OSError: The file cannot be written.

Make the calling Assistant the Topic's holder (decision 0006).

Args:
    request: The incoming request.
    topic_id: The Topic.
    actor: The Assistant.
    db: Database session.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 when there is no such Topic; 403 without an Assistant.

Write a Message with the number the writer believes is next (decision 0007).

Args:
    request: The incoming request.
    topic_id: The Topic.
    body: The Message.
    actor: The writer.
    db: Database session.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 when there is no such Topic; 409 ``number_taken`` with the unread
        Messages when the number is not next, or ``turn_limit`` when the Topic waits for
        a human; 422 for an unknown addressee, foreign files or a ``reply_to`` that is
        not an earlier Message of the Topic.

Record how far the caller has read a Topic; it leaves the Inbox when read through.

Args:
    topic_id: The Topic.
    body: Number of the newest Message read.
    actor: The caller.
    db: Database session.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 when there is no such Topic in the caller's Teams.
